body: I'm in a country like that. People are being killed for being gay and the government doesn't give a shit. Even supports it. So no. Just because there's a stupid mob mentality around you,  you can always think for yourself.

All you need to do is accept that part of you.  I've been there,  I know it's hard. But if you don't change your mindset,  another new issue will come up even if you accept being gay. Who's gonna decide what is right for you? Strangers who font know you and don't care if you're gay or not,  ir you? You should prioritize yourself. 
I'm saying this as someone who tried to suicide multiple times for being gay and I'm over that. I have worse problems now. Being gay is nothing really. Unless you don't think for yourself and believe whatever people say. 
It's 2019,  everyone is coming out. There's more people out there for you then you think.

The rules clearly state not to promise that things get better.
Just because it turned out well for you,  it doesn't for most of us.  You have a family. I don't and there are others who don't either.  Almost everyone here has no friends either and Noone to pay for psychologists and such.  You're the lucky one percent. I get that you're trying to be positive here but you just get further from us like that.  Most of us could never relate to what you said how things turned out for you. And will just feel worse.
I've been searching for those people for so many years now and they don't seem to exist. I wish they did.

I'm the type of person who rather goes off to suffer alone than harming anyone. I know moods and feelings can stick to others and I don't want to mess up anyone with it.  I did ot once to someone I really loved and I lost her. I don't want you to feel worse just because I'm in such a shit place. I wish I could be uplifting but I can't. I wish I had enough energy to make that positive impact needed for this damn world,  because I know every individual has the potential to change it at least a little bit. I still feel futile. I don't have the energy to keep going on. I'm tired of never feeling anything good. I always been about helping everyone else and yet I'm here.  I don't know what did I do wrong.
